evidence: Fixes a functional test for P2P transaction relay behavior to block-relay-only peers in test/functional/p2p_blocksonly.py
rationale: Fixes a vacuous assertion in `p2p_blocksonly.py` where a check for transaction announcement checked `txid` instead of `wtxid` on a `wtxidrelay` connection. The check previously passed regardless of whether the node announced the transaction, leaving P2P block-relay-only behavior unverified.
